content:
“Survival. Teamwork. Research. Discovery. Innovation. Open near your friends, so everyone can enjoy!”— Item description

The **Scout's Banner**, also referred to as **Battle Banner**, [1] is an aid item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.

## Gameplay[edit]

When using the banner, an animation that raises the banner plays, and adds three buffs:

- *Scout's Call* and*Scout's Code* , affects all players within a 75 meter radius.
- *Scout's Courage* , affects only the player that used the banner.

| Buff | Effect | Duration | 
| Scout's Call | 5-20% chance to trigger all currently obtained *Scout's Codes* upon killing an enemy. | 1 hour | 
| Scout's Code | One code added per activated banner within a 7.41 meter radius, code triggered by *Scout's Call* . Possible codes: Teamwork - Restores all AP Survival - Restores 20% of HP Innovation - 10% improved weapon condition Discovery - Highlights enemies for 5 seconds Research - 10% improved armor condition | 1 hour | 
| Scout's Courage | 100% chance to use a stimpak to auto-revive when incapacitated, 5 minute cooldown. | 1 hour | 

## Locations[edit]

- Can be obtained as reward from season scoreboards.
- Can be purchased in the Atomic Shop.

Buff duration is paused when leaving a server.
